name: askif-monorepo
description: Let Jev decide. Monorepo for askif and its backend packages.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter askif run build && pnpm --filter @askif/jev run build && pnpm --filter @askif/openai run build && pnpm --filter @askif/clef run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter askif run typecheck && pnpm --filter askif run build && pnpm --filter @askif/jev run typecheck && pnpm --filter @askif/openai run typecheck && pnpm --filter @askif/clef run typecheck && tsc -p .github/scripts/tsconfig.json && tsc -p bench/tsconfig.json && tsc -p live/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: pnpm --filter askif run build && pnpm --filter askif run test && pnpm --filter @askif/jev run test && pnpm --filter @askif/openai run test && pnpm --filter @askif/clef run test && node --import tsx --test live/exif.test.ts
scripts.test:live: pnpm --filter askif run build && node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 live/*.test.ts
scripts.test:live:jev: pnpm --filter askif run build && node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 live/jev.test.ts
scripts.test:live:clef: pnpm --filter askif run build && node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 live/exif.test.ts live/clef.test.ts
scripts.test:live:openai: pnpm --filter askif run build && node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 live/openai.test.ts
scripts.test:live:openrouter: pnpm --filter askif run build && node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 live/openrouter.test.ts
scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run docs:check
scripts.release: pnpm run build && pnpm exec tsx .github/scripts/publish.ts
